items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Jon has performed with Jim Dapogny’s Chicago Jazz Band and Vince Giordano’s Night Hawks.

ctx.x: Jon-Erik Kellso is one of the young instrumentalists keeping the mainstream jazz tradition alive. He was born in Dearborn, Michigan in 1964 and was first inspired by the swing records from his parents’ collection. His main influences were not from current trumpet players of his day, but from early pioneers including Bix Beiderbecke, Cootie Williams and Louis Armstrong. He played alongside Wild Bill Davison at 17 and was featured in the Montreux-Detroit Jazz Festival and J.C. Heard Orchestra. Jon has performed…
Jon was interviewed on September 12, 1997 in Chautauqua, New York by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
